Lemma
[Busemann bounds] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0479 ↗ def:chow-iii-i1-rays-busemann 1. appi:1.2,appi:1.3\group Busemann geometry

If $\gamma $ starts at $p$, then $|b_\gamma (x)|\le d(x,p)$ and $|b_\gamma (x)-b_\gamma (y)|\le d(x,y)$. The same two inequalities hold for $b_p$.
Proof

\sketch The triangle inequality bounds each finite expression $s-d(\gamma (s),x)$ by $\pm d(x,p)$ and bounds its difference at $x,y$ by $d(x,y)$. Pass to the limit and then take the supremum over rays from $p$.

□
